Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, dated 6 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 67,000 per month + 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B Tech/BE - Graduate degree of four years with three years post qualification experience. Desirable: experience in coding, managing and developing apps.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting. Interview. Only short-listed candidates will be called for interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post filled purely on temporary basis. Duration 12 months (extendable).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Centre for Community Medicine, AIIMS, New Delhi.
